request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fabric, building and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

AN ARTIST. A man of about sixty with white hair and round glasses, in a paint-stained shirt, sits at an easel by a window and paints a bowl of fruit on the canvas with a brush, a palette of paints in his other hand. He is plainly a painter at work. Exactly one person, whole upper body sharp and large in the middle of the photo; the workplace behind is plain to read but not crowded. No letters, words, numbers, logos, badges with writing or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.
